definitions.explanation: A formal talk given to an audience.

examples.japanese: {著名|ちょめい}な{講演|こうえん}{者|しゃ}
{大学|だいがく}で{講演|こうえん}をする。
examples.english: To give a lecture at a university.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{教授|きょうじゅ}の{講演|こうえん}{会|かい}に{参加|さんか}して、とても{勉強|べんきょう}になった。
examples.english: I attended a lecture by a famous professor, and it was very educational.

notes:
{講演|こうえん} is a formal lecture or speech given to an audience, typically on academic or professional topics.

WORD FORMATION:
{講|こう} (lecture) + {演|えん} (perform/speak)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {講演|こうえん}をする: to give a lecture
- {講演|こうえん}を{行|おこな}う: to deliver a lecture (formal)
- {講演|こうえん}を{聞|き}く: to attend a lecture
- {講演|こうえん}{会|かい}: lecture event
- {講演|こうえん}{者|しゃ}: lecturer, speaker
- {講演|こうえん}{料|りょう}: lecture fee
- {基調|きちょう}{講演|こうえん}: keynote speech

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {演説|えんぜつ}: speech (often political)
- {発表|はっぴょう}: presentation
- {授業|じゅぎょう}: class, lesson
